verdict.rationale: Limitless documents natural-language querying of your data. Its built-in Ask AI chats include tool calls and can run on a schedule, and its MCP server lets Claude and other MCP clients search and ask about Lifelogs in plain language. However, the evidence only covers asking questions about recorded data, not operating the product as a whole by natural-language command. Missing for 10: evidence that natural language can drive actions or settings (e.g., starring, deleting, exporting, configuring) beyond Q&A; first-party docs describing the Ask AI experience itself; independent hands-on corroboration.
